construct_fourier_bases: construct a d-dimensional Fourier basis matrix using complex exponential vectors for spectral analysis
load_model_trajectory: load a series of PyTorch model checkpoints from a directory and extract ABC weight matrices in Fourier space
load_model_trajectory_with_indices: load specific model checkpoints by index from a directory and compute their Fourier-transformed ABC matrices
process_folder_config: process a single experiment folder to extract and parse its configuration into a key-value dictionary
load_all_configs: load and parse configuration files from all subdirectories in a root folder using multiprocessing and return a DataFrame
